primitives.name: SHA-256 Integrity Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: `MANIFEST.md` itself is not listed because a file cannot contain its own final SHA-256 digest.
primitives.assumptions: SHA-256 is collision-resistant and deterministic for given input.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Verification fails if computed hash differs from stored hash or if file is corrupted.

layer2.mapping: Hash integrity corresponds to GSI's confidence measure over data fidelity; mismatch triggers Bayesian re-evaluation.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of verified files against total staged files.
